channel.title: VibePicks: new AI tool releases
channel.description: Verified AI tool and model launches that matter to people shipping apps, each with a source link.

item.title: Google Jules: Google is shutting down Jules, its background AI coding agent, to fold the idea into Antigravity: you can keep finishing…
item.description: Google is shutting down Jules, its background AI coding agent, to fold the idea into Antigravity: you can keep finishing sessions until November 11, then Jules goes read-only and winds down December 31, 2026. Export your settings, environment variables, scheduled tasks, memories, setup scripts and session history first with the Jules Tools CLI (npm install -g @google/jules); your code, branches and pull requests stay in GitHub

item.title: Google Antigravity: Antigravity now has a Plugin Marketplace in the Antigravity app and CLI: one-click plugins that bundle skills, MCP serve…
item.description: Antigravity now has a Plugin Marketplace in the Antigravity app and CLI: one-click plugins that bundle skills, MCP servers, rules, hooks and custom agents, so you no longer wire up each MCP server by hand. Launch partners include Atlassian, Canva, Datadog, Dropbox, Figma, Stripe and Unity, plus a Vercel plugin

item.title: Factory Droid: Factory released Droid 1.0, a rebuilt coding-agent harness whose default Script mode lets the model write a small sandbo…
item.description: Factory released Droid 1.0, a rebuilt coding-agent harness whose default Script mode lets the model write a small sandboxed JavaScript program that runs many tool calls in one request instead of one call at a time. Factory says that cuts cost about 15% on Claude Opus 5.5 and turned one 312-call cleanup into 2 requests; its benchmark wins are self-reported. On desktop, CLI and an SDK

item.title: OpenCode: OpenCode v2.2.1 adds /goal: give the session an objective and it keeps working until an automatic review confirms it is …
item.description: OpenCode v2.2.1 adds /goal: give the session an objective and it keeps working until an automatic review confirms it is done, with /goal pause, resume and clear. Also new: opt-in scheduled prompts (/schedule), an opt-in image_generate tool, live background-shell output in Desktop and a redesigned model picker

item.title: Vercel: Node.js 26 LTS is generally available on Vercel for builds and Functions and is now the default for new projects. Built-…
item.description: Node.js 26 LTS is generally available on Vercel for builds and Functions and is now the default for new projects. Built-in fetch uses HTTP/2 by default (set VERCEL_FETCH_DISABLE_H2=1 to keep HTTP/1.1), and you get the Temporal date API. Existing projects move to 26 on the next deploy if engines.node allows it, e.g. >=20

item.title: Vercel: Vercel Firewall can now treat AI crawlers (bots that collect pages for indexing and model training) and AI assistants (b…
item.description: Vercel Firewall can now treat AI crawlers (bots that collect pages for indexing and model training) and AI assistants (bots fetching a page to answer someone's question) separately, so you can block training crawlers but still let ChatGPT-style assistants read and cite your site. In the AI Bots managed ruleset, on all plans

item.title: GitHub Replica: GitHub Design open-sourced Replica (MIT license), an AI prototyping tool that turns plain-English ideas into interactive…
item.description: GitHub Design open-sourced Replica (MIT license), an AI prototyping tool that turns plain-English ideas into interactive prototypes built from your own design system's components, driven from the GitHub Copilot app, with an optional self-hosted Replica Hub for sharing and comments

item.title: GitHub Copilot: Copilot Fusion is generally available: pick Fusion in the model picker and Copilot routes and combines models for each t…
item.description: Copilot Fusion is generally available: pick Fusion in the model picker and Copilot routes and combines models for each task instead of you choosing one, with Standard, High and Max effort levels. GitHub says Fusion Max scored within two points of Claude Code with Opus 5.5 Max on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index at about half the cost. On all Copilot plans in VS Code, the Copilot app, Copilot CLI and JetBrains

item.title: GitHub Copilot: Copilot cloud sessions now follow you everywhere: start a cloud agent task on github.com, GitHub Mobile, Copilot CLI, th…
item.description: Copilot cloud sessions now follow you everywhere: start a cloud agent task on github.com, GitHub Mobile, Copilot CLI, the Copilot app, VS Code, Slack or Teams and pick it up on any of the others while it keeps running in a cloud sandbox. Sandbox time can come out of your included Actions minutes. Generally available on paid Copilot plans, rolling out from Oct 28; Copilot Projects for multi-repo goals are in public preview

item.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows: GitHub Agentic Workflows is generally available: write an automation (issue triage, CI failure analysis, docs updates, t…
item.description: GitHub Agentic Workflows is generally available: write an automation (issue triage, CI failure analysis, docs updates, test writing) as a plain-English Markdown file and it compiles to a normal GitHub Actions workflow run by Copilot or your own coding agent, read-only by default and sandboxed. On GitHub Free, Team and Enterprise; the default Copilot CLI engine needs a Copilot license

item.title: Supabase: OrioleDB is in public beta on every Supabase plan: an open-source Postgres storage engine built for tables with lots of …
item.description: OrioleDB is in public beta on every Supabase plan: an open-source Postgres storage engine built for tables with lots of updates and deletes, cutting the table bloat and VACUUM tuning the default engine needs. Choose it when you create a project; billed like standard Postgres, backups and read replicas work, but not ready for production yet

item.title: Vercel: The Vercel Plugin now works in OpenCode 2: install it with opencode plugin add github:vercel/vercel-plugin to get Vercel…
item.description: The Vercel Plugin now works in OpenCode 2: install it with opencode plugin add github:vercel/vercel-plugin to get Vercel skills (AI SDK, Functions, Workflow), /vercel:deploy and /vercel:env commands, and the Vercel MCP server so the agent can see your projects, deployments and logs

item.title: Supabase: Supabase Compute is in private alpha: run AI agents, background jobs and APIs (Node, Deno or any Dockerfile) inside your…
item.description: Supabase Compute is in private alpha: run AI agents, background jobs and APIs (Node, Deno or any Dockerfile) inside your Supabase project, next to your Postgres data, for minutes or hours instead of the 400-second Edge Function limit. Deploy with supabase compute push (CLI v2.120.0+); free during the alpha, us-west-2 projects only, waitlist required and not for production yet

item.title: Replit: Replit Cloud Agents let anyone on a team describe a change in plain English, watch it in a live preview of the running a…
item.description: Replit Cloud Agents let anyone on a team describe a change in plain English, watch it in a live preview of the running app, and have the agent open a tested pull request on GitHub (or merge request on GitLab) that follows the team's guidelines and keeps fixing it as review comments come in. Engineers still approve what ships. Available now on Pro and Enterprise

item.title: Cursor: Cursor design mode adds Annotate: give the agent visual prompts by editing elements, drawing right on the page, and revi…
item.description: Cursor design mode adds Annotate: give the agent visual prompts by editing elements, drawing right on the page, and reviewing your design at different screen sizes

item.title: Gemini API: Google released the Gemini API CLI (gemini-api) in beta, a stateless, zero-dependency command-line client built for AI c…
item.description: Google released the Gemini API CLI (gemini-api) in beta, a stateless, zero-dependency command-line client built for AI coding agents, scripts and CI pipelines. It uses the Interactions API to generate text and media, analyze files and run Gemini managed agents

item.title: Ramp Inspect: Ramp opened early access to Inspect, the cloud coding agent its own teams use: hand it a task from Slack, GitHub, Linear…
item.description: Ramp opened early access to Inspect, the cloud coding agent its own teams use: hand it a task from Slack, GitHub, Linear, the web or your phone (even a screenshot with "@inspect fix this") and it returns a visually checked, reviewed pull request. Sessions are multiplayer so teammates can jump in and steer. Ramp says it now writes 74% of the company's merged PRs

item.title: Vercel: Vercel Observability now shows AI traffic: requests by each verified AI bot, the pages AI crawlers hit most, pages AI as…
item.description: Vercel Observability now shows AI traffic: requests by each verified AI bot, the pages AI crawlers hit most, pages AI assistants fetch in answer to a user's question, Markdown requests, and pages that return errors to bots. Find it under Observability > AI Traffic; querying it from the CLI with vercel metrics needs Observability Plus

item.title: OpenCode: OpenCode v2.2.0 adds experimental desktop plugins you can create, install and share, a refreshed desktop app, experiment…
item.description: OpenCode v2.2.0 adds experimental desktop plugins you can create, install and share, a refreshed desktop app, experimental image-generation APIs for plugins, keyed session instructions that survive compaction without busting the prompt cache, and prompt-cache lifetimes you can set per provider and model. Heads-up: the OpenCode GitHub Action is no longer published, so remove it from your workflows

item.title: GPT-6.1 Terra (OpenAI): OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra, a fast, lower-cost model for computer use, visual reasoning and writing. On the API as gp…
item.description: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra, a fast, lower-cost model for computer use, visual reasoning and writing. On the API as gpt-6.1-terra at $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output (half the price of GPT-6.1 Sol), with a 1M-token context; also in ChatGPT and Codex for paid plans, and generally available in GitHub Copilot

item.title: Cursor: Cursor's Agent SDK is generally available: define an agent as a folder (instructions.md for the prompt, tools/ in TypeSc…
item.description: Cursor's Agent SDK is generally available: define an agent as a folder (instructions.md for the prompt, tools/ in TypeScript, skills, MCP connections), test it with built-in evals, and deploy it to Cursor with agent-sdk deploy or run it on your own servers. Agents can wake on GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket events, Slack messages, webhooks or a schedule

item.title: GitHub Copilot: Assisted permissions are generally available in Copilot CLI, the Copilot app and VS Code: an AI model checks each comman…
item.description: Assisted permissions are generally available in Copilot CLI, the Copilot app and VS Code: an AI model checks each command, file path or URL Copilot asks to use, lets clearly safe ones run, and still asks you about the rest. It's a middle ground between approving everything by hand and Allow All

item.title: Claude Code: v2.1.311 fixes long sessions stopping with "Usage credits required for 1M context" past 200K tokens (it now compacts and…
item.description: v2.1.311 fixes long sessions stopping with "Usage credits required for 1M context" past 200K tokens (it now compacts and keeps going), fixes multi-thousand-line edits stalling for up to 5 seconds, lets subagents use MCP servers that connect late, and typing ultrathink mid-turn now raises effort for the rest of that turn

item.title: Entire: Former GitHub CEO Thomas Dohmke's Entire launched a Git hosting platform built for coding agents: Trails replace pull re…
item.description: Former GitHub CEO Thomas Dohmke's Entire launched a Git hosting platform built for coding agents: Trails replace pull requests with agent-scored checks on every push, Continuous Memory saves agent sessions into the repo so agents can search past work, and Buildkite and Depot handle CI. Open to every developer today, with private repos only for now

item.title: Gemini API: New paid-tier projects now store Generate Content API requests by default (store=true), matching the Interactions API; o…
item.description: New paid-tier projects now store Generate Content API requests by default (store=true), matching the Interactions API; opt out per request with store=false or in Logs and Datasets settings

item.title: Vercel: Faster pnpm installs: dependency verification is reused across deployments, cutting average install time 14% on Pro, aut…
item.description: Faster pnpm installs: dependency verification is reused across deployments, cutting average install time 14% on Pro, automatic on all plans

item.description: Replit now works fully in Japanese, from the interface to prompts and agent output

item.title: Cloudflare WAF: Cloudflare added two emergency Managed Ruleset rules for the Node.js Brotli decoder flaw CVE-2026-111497 (memory leak or…
item.description: Cloudflare added two emergency Managed Ruleset rules for the Node.js Brotli decoder flaw CVE-2026-111497 (memory leak or code execution when decoding attacker-controlled Brotli data): one matches Brotli-encoded request bodies, one matches the Next.js image optimizer path /_next/image. Both default to Log, not Block. If you self-host Next.js or any Node app, upgrade Node.js to 22.23.4, 24.22.1 or 26.12.1

item.title: Vercel Connect: Vercel Connect can now create a separate restricted Stripe API key for each agent or task (Managed API Key method), limi…
item.description: Vercel Connect can now create a separate restricted Stripe API key for each agent or task (Managed API Key method), limited to the permissions you pick, so an agent never holds your full-access secret key. Vercel stores the key, and you can rotate it without redeploying

item.title: GitHub Copilot: The new GitHub app for Microsoft Teams combines notifications with Copilot: @mention GitHub on a bug report in a channel…
item.description: The new GitHub app for Microsoft Teams combines notifications with Copilot: @mention GitHub on a bug report in a channel or chat and it investigates, fixes the bug and opens a pull request for review. The legacy app is renamed GitHub (deprecated) and retires November 16

item.title: Cursor: Cursor agents can now control your computer: Computer Use lets them click and type across desktop apps, not just the bro…
item.description: Cursor agents can now control your computer: Computer Use lets them click and type across desktop apps, not just the browser, such as driving the iOS Simulator to test the features they build. Cursor uses it on its own when a task needs it, or you can @-mention Computer Use; update Cursor to get it

item.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro (Moonshot AI): Moonshot AI released Kimi K3.1 Pro, a 2.8T-parameter MoE model (104B active) with a 1M-token context and image input, ai…
item.description: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3.1 Pro, a 2.8T-parameter MoE model (104B active) with a 1M-token context and image input, aimed at full-project coding and long agent runs. It is live on the Kimi API and Vercel AI Gateway (moonshotai/kimi-k3.1-pro, plus a faster Highspeed version), with open weights planned by November 4

item.title: Replit: Replit launched Monitoring Agent, an on-call agent that investigates production issues from your app's logs and metrics,…
item.description: Replit launched Monitoring Agent, an on-call agent that investigates production issues from your app's logs and metrics, then attempts and validates fixes (with optional auto-fix and experimental auto-republish). Also new: Agent-made reusable skills, chat and asset sharing, Stripe Atlas incorporation at 20% off, and published apps that keep running at zero credits for eligible top-up customers

item.title: Chroma: Chroma, the open-source vector database, signed a deal to join Replit. Chroma Cloud is winding down: writes stop Novembe…
item.description: Chroma, the open-source vector database, signed a deal to join Replit. Chroma Cloud is winding down: writes stop November 22, 2026 and reads stop December 22, 2026, so cloud users need to export and migrate. Open-source ChromaDB stays Apache 2.0

item.description: TanStack AI hits 1.0 with stable core APIs: an open-source, no-lock-in toolkit for adding chat, tools, MCP, media and agents to your app, with 23 provider adapters, eight UI frameworks and a new experimental agent harness

item.description: Anthropic donated Agent Skills, the open SKILL.md standard used by 70+ agent platforms including ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and VS Code, to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation, so skills you write stay vendor-neutral

item.description: The Decisions API is now generally available: you define a question and its allowed answers and get fast, low-cost classification, routing and next-action picks for apps and agents, up to 10x faster than GPT-6 Luna through the Responses API, now with prompt caching, JSON and image inputs and up to 400 questions per request

item.description: Agents SDK v0.30.0 runs PiHarness on Pi 1.4, so agents can hibernate while tasks sleep, park tasks that keep crashing, and recover from storage errors and cut-off model streams; the upgrade can't be rolled back past Pi 1.4
